item.text:
The F27 follow-up compared the same single-PREACCEPT recovery under captured code and the naive sub-case 4 guard:

- Captured fallback: commits NOOP on all five replicas ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_subcase4_cluster_output.txt)).
- Naive sub-case 4: commits the PUT on all five ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix15_subcase4_cluster_output.txt)).

Both results are safe for an unchosen value, but they show the branch changes recovery behavior. The real problem remains the complex randomized cases: the guessed `f/2` guard stalls 85/500 recoveries in PREACCEPTED even after adding the F6/F12/F17 fixes. It stays a negative diagnostic rather than a recommended fix.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. The new contrast is recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
